item.text: I’ll read `input.json` and check each candidate start against the availability, blackout, window, and deadline constraints.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open(\"input.json\")); n=d[\"duration\"]; starts=[s for s in range(d[\"window_start\"],d[\"window_end\"]-n+1) if s+n<=d[\"deadline\"] and all(all(any(a<=t<b for a,b in intervals) for t in range(s,s+n)) for intervals in d[\"teams\"].values()) and not any(s<b and a<s+n for a,b in d[\"blackouts\"])]; print(json.dumps(dict(feasible_starts=starts,earliest=min(starts) if starts else None,latest=max(starts) if starts else None)))'"
